source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check CPLD is stability after flah stress
1. Boot into OS.
2. Use tool to flash last CPLD version file.
3. Reboot and boot into OS.
4. Check the CPLD version.
5. Repeat step 1~4 for 100 times.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Make sure no error message in BMC log.2. Make sure CPLD could work after stress test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: CPLD flash tool + boot controller script
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Blind 100-cycle SSH loop using flash_cpld, systemctl reboot and a fixed 20-second sleep.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Per-cycle flash, reboot and version results.
deepseek_columns.risk: 100 CPLD flash and reboot cycles can leave the platform unbootable if a write or recovery fails.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes the vendor package and high-risk repeated firmware writes but proposes a blind fixed-delay loop without state validation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires exact board/CPLD/image/tool/recovery, OOB monitoring, per-cycle verification and preserved BMC/SEL evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; treats package/approval as the capability boundary and retains the 100-cycle stress intent.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Rejects a fixed 20-second sleep and requires milestone-based boot/reconnect/version evidence.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the identified CPLD can survive 100 consecutive approved firmware-programming and reboot cycles while retaining the intended version, platform functionality and clean BMC health evidence.
original_method: For each of 100 cycles, boot the SUT, program the exact approved CPLD image with the supported vendor tool, verify the write, perform a controlled reboot, wait for explicit boot and management milestones, confirm the same CPLD version and capture BMC/platform health before advancing.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies and approves the exact CPLD/image/tool, 100-cycle plan and recovery boundary, and later issues the verdict. No manual physical stimulus is inherent when the supported updater, reboot control, version query and OOB recovery path are electronically accessible.
required_inputs: Exact board, CPLD device/revision, current and approved target version
Signed target image/hash, vendor updater/version/exact syntax and referenced flash-stress script content/version
Compatibility, write-verify behavior, reboot requirements and vendor recovery procedure
Approved 100-cycle duration or explicit project override, stable power, maintenance window and workload state
Mapped version query, OOB/BMC access, boot/reconnect milestones, timeouts and stop policy
safety_requirements: Bind every write to the exact CPLD and image; never select an unbounded 'last' image or wildcard device.
Use a state machine that requires successful transfer, verify, reboot, OOB reachability, OS readiness and mapped version evidence before the next cycle.
Stop immediately on identity/hash/verify mismatch, loss of required OOB recovery, unrecoverable boot failure, critical power/thermal event or safety-stop condition.
Preserve the first failure and all prior cycle evidence; do not auto-retry, hide a failure, switch images or continue a firmware write after a critical anomaly.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the target/image/tool/script/recovery manifest and capture cycle-zero CPLD, BMC/SEL, boot and platform-health baselines.
After one-user approval, orchestrate up to the approved cycle count with explicit per-cycle flash/verify/reboot/reconnect/version gates and continuous raw evidence preservation.
Summarize completed cycles, first anomaly and final health as Tool Result while leaving PASS/FAIL to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact target, image/hash, updater/script, cycle count, stable-power and recovery plan.
Remain available for vendor-directed recovery if a flash or boot safety stop occurs.
Review per-cycle and final functional/BMC evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed for-loop, direct reboot and fixed sleep are unsafe and insufficient: elapsed time is not proof of write verification, POST completion, reconnect readiness or correct CPLD identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the validated vendor updater inside a persisted state machine that records cycle identity and requires flash verification, controlled reboot, OOB/OS readiness and mapped version confirmation before advancement.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The master requirement of 100 repetitions, OS flash/reboot/version method, referenced script and 50/2500-minute fields are preserved; any approved lower project count is reported only as that plan's completion.

modernized_recommendation.status: STATEFUL WRAPPER AROUND THE EXISTING VENDOR METHOD
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Retain the approved vendor flash operation but add a durable cycle ledger, exact artifact hashes, milestone-based reboot/reconnect checks, per-cycle mapped version and BMC/SEL deltas, and an explicit non-retry safety stop.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/CPLD/BIOS/BMC, updater, referenced script and image versions/hashes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved vendor CPLD programming/recovery documentation and the referenced internal flash-stress script; neither was available in the repository.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a blind loop/fixed delay with evidence-driven state transitions without replacing the CPLD update method.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; all approved programming cycles, reboots, correct-version checks, BMC-log acceptance and final CPLD functionality remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Validated programming manifest, script content and recovery/stop policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated nonvolatile writes can expose power-loss, boot and endurance failures; automation cannot declare the engineering verdict.

project_override_considerations: The public library retains 100 cycles. A project may approve fewer cycles, but the report must state the approved count and may claim only that project-plan completion—not completion of the master 100-cycle stress requirement.
expected_evidence: Cycle-zero CPLD version, BMC/SEL, OS/boot, power/thermal and platform-health baseline
For every attempted cycle: index, timestamps, full flash/verify output, reboot/OOB/OS milestones, mapped version and BMC/SEL delta
First-failure and safety-stop evidence without retry, completed-cycle count, final CPLD/platform functionality, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently define 100 flash/reboot repetitions with version, BMC-log and final CPLD-health acceptance. 'Last' requires project pinning but does not create contradictory source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and acceptance intent are clear. Missing image/tool/script/recovery artifacts are readiness gates; after supply and approval the entire electronic cycle and evidence path can be automated.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains package and firmware risk but rejects its unsafe blind loop and PARTIAL classification based only on package supply.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its exact identity, stable-power, recovery and state-check requirements while classifying the executable core as FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds an atomic per-cycle ledger, explicit safety stops, master-versus-project count reporting and first-failure preservation.

review_improvement: Turns an unsafe blind firmware loop into a bounded evidence-preserving stress plan without weakening the 100-cycle source requirement or conflating approval with capability.
independent_technical_reasoning: Each core action—supported CPLD programming, verification, controlled reboot, reachability, version readback and log capture—is electronically automatable. High firmware risk, package supply and engineer verdict remain readiness, safety and governance dimensions rather than reasons to label the core PARTIAL.

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a failed programming or reboot cycle automatically. Preserve the first failure, stop at the defined boundary and invoke only the approved recovery procedure under engineer control.
